en.summary: This commit fixes CSC post-extension handling by replacing hard-coded internal widths with entry-size parameters and by rebuilding the request element mask from all active sub-height partitions instead of only the first partition.
why_it_counts: The patch touches only CSC RTL implementation files.
It corrects active-element masking and intermediate shifted-data sizing, both of which affect delivered image data.
The old code clearly contained hard-coded widths and a single-partition mask path marked as needing update for image handling.
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v changes several dat_rsp_l*_sft staging registers from fixed 256/512-bit widths to CBUF_ENTRY_BITS.
NV_NVDLA_CSC_wl.v changes wt_req_vld_bit and wt_req_emask_p1/p2/p3 to CSC_ATOMC-based widths.
wt_req_mask_w is changed from a single wt_req_emask_p0 path to a sub_h_total-dependent composition of p0/p1/p2/p3 mask fragments.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When an image or feature-map fetch is post-extended across multiple sub-height partitions, the loader must preserve the full entry width of shifted data and must build the valid-element mask from every active sub-partition. If the implementation assumes stale fixed widths or collapses the mask to only the first partition, the logic will drop or misalign parts of the fetched entry and pass the wrong valid-byte pattern to later stages.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: multi-partition element-mask assembly and shifted-entry staging
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Image/post-extension traffic uses more than one sub-height partition or uses an entry width larger than the old hard-coded intermediate storage.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce narrow fixed-width intermediate buffers or compute the request mask from only the first partition instead of all active partitions.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: restore stale fixed-width mask and slice assembly
portability_notes: Map this to the block that packs or shifts fetched image data before delivery to the compute path.
The portable fault is not tied to CSC naming; any design with sub-line packing and per-element valid masks can exhibit the same bug.
If another DUT uses different partition counts, the same fault can be injected by ignoring later partitions in the composed mask.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the parameterized registers or wires that hold a shifted cache or buffer entry for image/post-extension handling.
Narrow one or more of those intermediates back to an older fixed width so upper bits are lost for larger entries.
In the mask-generation path, stop composing the final valid-element mask from all active sub-partitions and instead keep only the first partition's mask.
Leave the downstream byte-count or request-update logic unchanged so the mask/data mismatch becomes observable.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC shifted response staging and sub-height request-mask generation
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix widens dat_rsp_l0/l1/l2/l3 shifted staging registers to CBUF_ENTRY_BITS and rebuilds wt_req_mask_w from p0/p1/p2/p3 element masks according to sub_h_total instead of always using wt_req_emask_p0.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_CSC_wl.v, restore wt_req_mask_w to the old single wt_req_emask_p0 path and revert the p1/p2/p3 and wt_req_vld_bit widths to their fixed constants. In NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v, restore the fixed 256/512-bit dat_rsp_l*_sft staging declarations.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Post-extended image data is masked or shifted incorrectly, causing missing elements, misaligned data lanes, or corrupted CSC input data on affected image configurations.
evidence_for_injection: The original code explicitly had a comment saying the single-mask form needed update for image handling.
The fix changes both mask composition and intermediate storage width, showing the bug spans logic semantics rather than formatting.
All modified files are central CSC datapath RTL files.
notes: The most portable reinjection is to collapse the composite mask back to the first partition.
Restoring the fixed-width shifted-data staging is a secondary but still grounded mutation from the same commit.

zh.summary: 该提交通过去除硬编码中间位宽，并把请求元素掩码改为由所有有效 sub-height 分片共同组成，而不再只使用第一段，修复了 CSC 的 post-extension 处理错误。
why_it_counts: 补丁只修改了 CSC 的 RTL 实现文件。
它同时修正了有效元素掩码和中间移位数据位宽，这两者都会影响最终输出的图像数据。
旧代码中既存在明显的硬编码位宽，也存在被注释标明需要为 image 更新的单分片掩码路径。
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v 把多个 dat_rsp_l*_sft 级间寄存器从固定 256/512 位改成了 CBUF_ENTRY_BITS。
NV_NVDLA_CSC_wl.v 把 wt_req_vld_bit 和 wt_req_emask_p1/p2/p3 改成基于 CSC_ATOMC 的位宽。
wt_req_mask_w 从仅使用 wt_req_emask_p0 改为按 sub_h_total 组合 p0/p1/p2/p3 掩码片段。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当图像或特征图读取需要跨多个 sub-height 分片做 post-extension 时，加载逻辑必须保留完整 entry 宽度的移位数据，并且必须从所有有效分片共同构造最终的有效元素掩码。如果实现仍假设旧的固定宽度，或者把掩码退化为只看第一段分片，那么部分 entry 数据会被截断或错位，后续阶段看到的有效字节模式也会错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多分片元素掩码拼接与移位 entry 暂存
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: image/post-extension 流量使用了多个 sub-height 分片，或者 entry 宽度超过旧硬编码中间缓存的表示范围。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新引入过窄的固定宽度中间缓存，或者把请求掩码退化为只根据第一段分片生成。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: restore stale fixed-width mask and slice assembly
portability_notes: 可映射到任何在送往计算路径前对图像数据做移位、拼接和逐元素掩码控制的模块。
该故障机理不依赖 CSC 命名；只要设计存在按子行分片打包和逐元素有效位，就能复现。
若目标 DUT 的分片数量不同，也可以通过忽略后续分片来复现同类故障。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位负责 image/post-extension 处理中间 entry 移位暂存的参数化寄存器或线网。
把其中一到多个中间缓存缩回旧的固定窄位宽，使较大 entry 的高位被截掉。
在掩码生成路径中，不再从所有有效 sub-partition 组合最终 valid-element mask，而是只保留第一段分片的掩码。
保持下游字节计数或请求更新逻辑不变，使掩码与数据内容失配能够暴露出来。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC 响应移位暂存与 sub-height 请求掩码生成
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 dat_rsp_l0/l1/l2/l3 的移位暂存寄存器统一扩展为 CBUF_ENTRY_BITS，并把 wt_req_mask_w 改成按 sub_h_total 由 p0/p1/p2/p3 元素掩码组合而成，而不再始终只用 wt_req_emask_p0。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CSC_wl.v 中把 wt_req_mask_w 恢复为旧的单一 wt_req_emask_p0 路径，并把 p1/p2/p3 与 wt_req_vld_bit 的位宽恢复为旧的固定常量；在 NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v 中把 dat_rsp_l*_sft 暂存声明改回固定 256/512 位。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 受影响图像配置下，post-extension 数据会被错误掩码或错误移位，表现为元素缺失、数据 lane 错位，或 CSC 输入数据损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 旧代码里明确注释了单掩码形式需要为 image 做更新。
该修复同时修改了掩码拼接和中间存储位宽，说明问题是实质性的逻辑错误而不是样式调整。
所有改动都落在 CSC 的关键数据通路 RTL 文件中。
notes: 最可移植的重新注入方式是把复合掩码退化回只看第一段分片。
恢复固定宽度的移位暂存也是同一提交所支持的次级注入点。
